title: Decisions
subtitle: Deterministic review recommendations from your metrics, diagnostics, forecast and economics. Nothing is executed automatically.
reviewOnly: Review recommendations only — nothing is executed automatically.
reasonDataQualityOrTrackingMismatch: A tracking or data-quality mismatch is detected — review before trusting performance.
reasonDataQualityIssueDetected: Data quality issues affect the reliability of this decision.
reasonNotEnoughEvidence: Not enough trustworthy evidence to make a decision.
reasonCampaignStillLearning: The campaign is still gathering enough data to be evaluated.
reasonPersistentUnprofitability: Persistent unprofitability below break-even — review whether to keep spending.
reasonProfitablePerformance: Profitable and healthy performance — review a safe incremental budget increase.
reasonPerformanceBottleneck: A performance bottleneck is holding results back — review the specific finding.
reasonHealthyPerformance: Healthy performance, no bottleneck detected — keep monitoring.
noDecisionsBody: Run a wider range or check that data is synced.
